source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

parts.when: [Opponent's Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), after an enemy unit shoots.
parts.target: An **ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT** unit of yours that was a target of any of that enemy unit's attacks.
parts.effect: You can pick a unit embarked in that **TRANSPORT**: it can [disembark](vsdata:core-rule/disembarking) as it could in your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), then it can shoot as it could in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase). It can only shoot at that enemy unit, and cannot shoot if that unit is not an eligible target.

data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), after an enemy unit shoots.

**Target:** An **ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT** unit of yours that was a target of any of that enemy unit's attacks.

**Effect:** You can pick a unit embarked in that **TRANSPORT**: it can [disembark](vsdata:core-rule/disembarking) as it could in your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), then it can shoot as it could in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase). It can only shoot at that enemy unit, and cannot shoot if that unit is not an eligible target.

windows.trigger: after an enemy unit has shot
